data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 开发室里的突发吻痕
data.description: 狭窄的元器件储物间内，呼吸交叠得毫无缝隙。红莉栖被抵在木质货架旁，双手下意识攥紧对方的衣角，半咬着下唇承受着滚烫的吻，眼角泛起失控的水汽。
data.location: narrow secluded parts storage closet between tall wooden shelving units
data.action: 红莉栖被抵在木质货架旁，双手下意识攥紧对方的衣角，半咬着下唇承受着滚烫的吻
data.lighting: dim amber light filtering under door crack illuminating flushed damp skin
data.promptProse: Inside a narrow, dimly lit component storage room lined with wooden shelves, Kurisu is backed close against the shelving gripping her partner's clothes tightly as tears shimmer at the corners of her flushed eyes.
data.animaCaption: Pressed back against a wooden storage-room shelf with both hands clutching her partner's shirt hem, she bites her lip through glistening tears during a heated kiss as her white ribbed halter camisole slips slightly off her flushed shoulder.
data.nsfwProse: Her minimalist white ribbed halter camisole sits slightly skewed over her bare flushed shoulders and collarbone above frayed high-waisted denim shorts.
